# Australia

Region: Oceania. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Australian Payments Network / Reserve Bank of Australia

**Role:** Industry standards body / RITS RTGS operator

**Reporting coverage:** HVCS interbank payment+investigation profile; no052/053 statement profile established

**Messages / versions:** pacs.008.001.09; pacs.009.001.09; pacs.004.001.10; camt.056.001.09; camt.029.001.10

- [RITS SWIFTInterfaceUserGuideJan2025](https://www.rba.gov.au/rits/info/pdf/RITSWIFT_Interface_User_Guide.pdf) — payment-guideline; public-file
- [HVCS migration announcement](https://www.auspaynet.com.au/insights/Media-Release/HVCS20022) — availability; public-page

The RBA guide enumerates exact HVCS payment and investigation message versions. CAMT029 and CAMT056 concern investigations and cancellations, not account statements. AusPayNet coordinates HVCS and distributes usage guidelines through industry and MyStandards channels. Migration occurred on 2023-03-20.
